34.desc: System fault state - camera halted due to fatal error

entries.title: System Fault State (State 34)
entries.meaning: The camera state machine transitioned to state 34 (SYSTEM_ERROR). This halts camera operation and prevents preview/recording. Usually triggered by a coprocessor failure, link drop, or sensor timeout.
entries.action: Inspect previous log lines for specific trigger events (C2C_ERROR, FAILED_IOB, X12, SENS_INIT) to identify the failing board.

entries.title: System Error: C2C Mailbox Failure
entries.meaning: Chip-to-Chip mailbox communication failed between the main OMAP processor and the ISP or IOB coprocessors.
entries.action: Check coprocessor heartbeat registers and ISP/IOB power supply rails.

entries.title: System Error: RED Data Stream Fault
entries.meaning: Corrupted or missing frame packet sequence in the RED Data Stream pipeline from sensor to encoder.
entries.action: Verify sensor calibration and check for SERDES lane errors.

entries.title: System Error: DDR Memory Fault
entries.meaning: DDR memory self-test or write leveling routine failed, or data parity error detected during operation.
entries.action: Check DDR supply voltages (ISP/Vcc_Isp 1.5V, IOB/Vcc 1.5V) and thermal readings.

entries.title: System Error: Dropped Frames
entries.meaning: Frame pipeline buffer overflow during recording. The media write speed could not sustain camera data rate.
entries.action: Check media write performance, SATA retry counts, and reduce REDCODE compression ratio.

entries.title: System Error: IOB Coprocessor Hang
entries.meaning: The I/O Board coprocessor (handling SATA, HDMI, SPI) became unresponsive or crashed.
entries.action: Inspect IOB core voltage (IOB/Vcc 1.0V) and check if SATA or HDMI peripheral caused a bus hang.

entries.title: System Error: Media Recording Failure
entries.meaning: Unrecoverable write error to the MINI-MAG media drive during active record.
entries.action: Verify MINI-MAG SSD health, inspect SATA connector pins, and check media format status.

entries.title: System Error: General I/O Error
entries.meaning: Storage subsystem I/O error occurred on internal NAND Flash or filesystem mount.
entries.action: Check NAND bad block table and /env partition integrity.

entries.title: System Error: Audio Buffer Overflow
entries.meaning: Audio DSP DMA FIFO overrun; audio samples were lost during capture.
entries.action: Check DSP clock sync and brain audio board communication.

entries.title: System Error: Sensor Init Timeout
entries.meaning: Image sensor power-up, register sequencing, or reset release timed out.
entries.action: Inspect sensor analog and digital power rails (Vdda 5.0V, Vdd 1.8V, Vdd_Tx 5.0V).

entries.title: System Error: X12 Sensor Link Failure
entries.meaning: The 12-lane high-speed serial link between sensor and ISP failed to lock, align, or pass PRBS tests.
entries.action: Inspect sensor flexible interconnect cable, clean connector contacts, and run test x12 status.

entries.title: System Error: Firmware Upgrade Failed
entries.meaning: Firmware upgrade verification, signature check, or flash sector write failed.
entries.action: Re-stage clean upgrade package; do not power off before verifying bootloader slot status.

entries.title: XAUI PCS Lane Sync Loss (Code 103)
entries.meaning: Physical Coding Sublayer error 103 on the XAUI interconnect between IOB and ISP. Indicates loss of 8b/10b symbol alignment or lane disparity mismatch during DMA transfers.
entries.action: Check ISP/IOB high-speed link signals and verify XAUI PCS status registers.

entries.title: XAUI PCS Transceiver Error
entries.meaning: Physical Coding Sublayer transmission error detected on inter-processor XAUI link.
entries.action: Run dsmcdbg log health or test x4 status to assess link degradation.

entries.title: XAUI PCS All Lanes Out of Sync
entries.meaning: All 4 XAUI receiver lanes report 0xf (unaligned / no lock). The ISP cannot receive video data from IOB.
entries.action: Check ISP power and clocks (0x88900034); check board seating.

entries.title: XAUI DMA Controller Timeout
entries.meaning: Direct memory access transfer over XAUI timed out waiting for FIFO ready flag.
entries.action: Check for buffer exhaustion or clock jitter on the coprocessor bus.

entries.title: C2C Packet Receive Error
entries.meaning: Chip-to-Chip inter-core mailbox packet CRC failure or sequence number mismatch.
entries.action: Monitor frequency; isolated retries are tolerated, continuous bursts indicate dying core.

entries.title: SERDES Lane Bit Errors
entries.meaning: Bit error counter on high-speed serial lane incremented.
entries.action: Check sensor cable termination and eye margin if count is high (>100).

entries.title: Media Authentication Failed
entries.meaning: MINI-MAG failed hardware cryptographic challenge. Drive will mount read-only or be rejected.
entries.action: Verify media is genuine RED MINI-MAG or that custom media patch is active.

entries.title: SATA HBA Command Timeout
entries.meaning: SATA host bus adapter timed out issuing ATA read/write commands to SSD.
entries.action: Inspect MINI-MAG connector pins for contamination or bent contacts.

entries.title: Startup Error: Primary Board Fault (0x01)
entries.meaning: Critical startup exception (Code 0x01). The main ARM processor failed to establish communication or power-good handshake with an internal processing board (most commonly the IOB or ISP board). Camera halts into forced shutdown.
entries.action: Strip camera down to bare brain. Power strictly with official RED AC wall adapter (no battery plates). Inspect internal flex ribbon seating and IOB/ISP power rails.

entries.title: Startup Error: Peripheral / Accessory Bus Fault (0x1D)
entries.meaning: Startup check exception (Code 0x1D). A peripheral, module, or accessory on the external communication bus (side handle, top plate, lens mount) timed out or experienced a communication pin fault.
entries.action: Detach all external modules, handles, and lens mount. Clean connector gold leaf pins and test booting with only direct RED LCD attached.

entries.title: Startup/Media Error: Storage Bus Fault (0x20)
entries.meaning: Storage subsystem communication failure or partition table corruption (Code 0x20 / 0x00000020). The camera cannot mount or initialize the SSD media interface.
entries.action: Perform a Secure Format of the SSD via REDCINE-X PRO or camera menu. Clean the MINI-MAG connector pins. Re-seat SSD side module.

entries.title: SDI Output Driver / Blown Port Fault
entries.meaning: I2C communication failure to the TI LMH0340 HD/3G SDI serializer chip. This is the classic signature of an SDI port fried by hot-plugging accessories or ESD ground loops over BNC.
entries.action: SDI driver IC or protection diode is likely damaged. Test HDMI and RED Touch LCD outputs to verify core brain health. Replace IOB board or damaged LMH0340 IC.

entries.title: Thermal / Fan Subsystem Fault
entries.meaning: Cooling fan tachometer sensor failed to read RPM, fan driver initialization failed, or digital temperature sensor stopped responding. Camera will enter safety shutdown to prevent ASIC/sensor damage.
entries.action: Inspect cooling fans for debris, dust clogging, or disconnected 4-pin fan header cables. Test fan RPM in maintenance diagnostic menu.

entries.title: Sensor Calibration / Black Shading Fault
entries.meaning: Sensor black shading calibration is missing, corrupted, or invalid for the current sensor operating temperature or exposure time (exceeds 3 stops from calibration). Produces fixed-pattern noise or yellow/red T/E indicators.
entries.action: Allow camera to reach stable operating temperature (approx 15-20 min), attach body cap securely to block all light, and perform a fresh Black Shading calibration.

entries.title: SATA Controller Physical Layer Fault
entries.meaning: SATA host bus controller failed ATA identify command or read/write LBA transfer to the internal SSD controller.
entries.action: Check MINI-MAG media drive health on a PC/Mac. Inspect 1.8" / MINI-MAG connector pins inside media bay for bent pins or metal contamination.

entries.title: Media Integrity / Filesystem Corruption
entries.meaning: The camera detected filesystem corruption or bad sectors on the active storage partition. Further recording is blocked.
entries.action: Back up existing footage using REDCINE-X PRO with verification, then perform a Secure Format on the camera.

entries.title: Power Rail / Voltage Regulator Fault
entries.meaning: Hardware power supervisory circuit detected an undervoltage, overvoltage, or short-circuit on internal power rails (ISP 1.0V/1.5V, IOB 1.0V/1.8V, or Aux Power).
entries.action: Test camera strictly on official RED AC power adapter. Check battery plate contact pins and monitor rail voltages in debug shell.

entries.title: RTC Coin Battery / NVRAM Settings Reset
entries.meaning: Non-volatile parameter database (CDB2) was reset or camera clock lost sync, typically caused by a depleted internal backup coin-cell battery (CR1220/CR2032) or sudden power disconnection during write.
entries.action: Replace the internal CR1220 real-time clock coin-cell battery. Reset camera date/time and re-apply user presets.

entries.title: Lens Mount / Motor Communication Fault
entries.meaning: Camera communication error with electronic lens mount contacts (Canon EF, Nikon, PL /i) or internal autofocus/iris motor timeout.
entries.action: Remove lens mount, clean gold contact pins with isopropyl alcohol, check pogo ribbon cable connection between mount and brain.

entries.title: Hex Error Code
entries.meaning: Generic subsystem return code indicating a non-zero error condition.
entries.action: Correlate with contemporaneous subsystem lines to isolate fault origin.

entries.title: CDB2 Parameter DB Error
entries.meaning: Settings database operational error occurred (e.g. database busy, schema constraint).
entries.action: Check factory.db and user preset file permissions.

entries.title: RCP Protocol Syntax Error
entries.meaning: RED Command Protocol parser encountered an invalid parameter ID or malformed command.
entries.action: Verify external control software version matches camera firmware RCP specification.
